title: rhombus.rocks shared config
description: Shared config for @rhombus.rocks/fnclaude, @rhombus.rocks/fngit, and the worktree-paths Claude Code plugin.

repos.description: Repo location and naming settings. Read by fngit and the worktree-paths plugin.

cloneTemplate.description: Where fngit clones repos to. Placeholders: {repo} {owner} {host} {host-plain} {host-short}.

worktreeTemplate.description: Where worktrees are created. Read by fngit (search exclusion) and worktree-paths (worktree creation). Placeholders: the cloneTemplate set plus {input} {branch} {clone-path} {repo-dir} {cwd}.

additionalSrcDirs.description: Extra directories fngit searches for an existing clone before asking GitHub. Search-only — never a clone destination. Entries may be one-level globs (`*`; no recursive walk).

hostAliases.description: Overrides for the {host-short} placeholder, keyed by host. Built-in defaults: github.com=gh, gitlab.com=gl, bitbucket.org=bb, codeberg.org=cb.
